repos.name: wow-look-at-my/buildhost
repos.description: Universal package registry. Upload a release artifact once, then download it as a raw binary, tar.gz/xz/zst, zip, deb, Homebrew formula, npm package, or OCI image. Also serves per-branch static sites. Live instance: pazer.build.

repos.name: wow-look-at-my/go-toolchain
repos.description: The org's single entry point for building, testing, and tidying Go. Replaces every bare go command, downloads its own toolchain, auto-formats, and ships a GitHub Action that runs the same code CI runs.

repos.name: wow-look-at-my/actions
repos.description: Reusable GitHub Actions, one per directory, each published to its own orphan tag such as @typescript#latest. Covers typed inline TypeScript steps, caching, GHCR, secret fetching, and release downloads.

repos.name: wow-look-at-my/js-snippets
repos.description: Browser ES modules served straight from GitHub Pages: vector and matrix math, noise and sampling, WebGPU and WebGL2 helpers, and custom elements such as code-editor, perf-graph, and timeline-view. Import by URL, no bundler.

repos.name: wow-look-at-my/secret-server
repos.description: Read-only secret vending for CI. Authenticates a caller by GitHub Actions OIDC token and exports every secret that caller is entitled to. There is no matching GitHub Actions secret to configure.

repos.name: wow-look-at-my/xml-validator
repos.description: Pure-Go XML 1.1 parser and XSD validator, strict by construction, with a GitHub Action that validates using the same binary. Chosen over libxml2 because libxml2 is not an XML 1.1 processor.

repos.name: wow-look-at-my/cc-marketplace
repos.description: The org's Claude Code plugin marketplace. Each plugin is a directory with a plugin.json; CI builds it, publishes it to the npm registry on buildhost, and smoke-tests the published marketplace.

repos.name: PazerOP/pr-preview-action
repos.description: GitHub Action that deploys a pull request preview to GitHub Pages, comments the URL and a QR code on the pull request, and removes the preview when the pull request closes.
